name: Unused/Unsupported Cloud Regions

evidence.rationale: Apply cloud configuration baselines that deactivate unused regions to reduce unmanaged cloud attack surface and help prevent adversaries from creating cloud instances in unused geographic service regions in order to evade detection.

This relationship applies when penetration testing identifies the described software configuration weakness and remediation of the finding changes disables or restricts unused cloud regions and services so adversaries cannot create or operate resources in locations outside the organization's intended monitoring and governance scope.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
